critique.evidence: The core instruction and next action are explicit: “Change one synthetic event,” the controls are labeled, and the high-contrast “LAUNCH EVENT” CTA leads into a side-by-side policy result. However, responsive navigation obscures the hero on desktop and the Amount control on tablet. Result interpretation is also muddy: “WHY BLUE DECIDED” is not connected explicitly to Intent Integrity, while suspicious reasons and a 13% economic signal appear alongside fused risk 0/100 and ALLOW without explaining that reconciliation.
critique.fix: Prevent the navigation from overlapping content at every viewport, rename the rationale heading to “Why Intent Integrity decided,” and add one concise sentence explaining how the evidence-layer percentages produce the fused-risk score and final decision.
